advantages.a1: 50 coins after every successful monthly Premium payment.
advantages.a2: Advanced training automation and rider-development analysis.
advantages.a3: Premium transfer tools: saved searches, automatic alerts, shortlist and negotiation analysis.
advantages.a4: Additional equipment setup slots and expanded included garage capacity.
advantages.a5: Access to advanced team-policy options and selected calendar filters.
advantages.a6: Additional external-rider history, recent results and career-honours views.
advantages.a7: Premium convenience features never improve race results, transfer acceptance or hidden rider skills.
